title: Three Days Left  (残るは三日間)

segments.t: 日曜日の朝、ポートランドのリンデン中庭インでは、カフェコーナーのそばで心配事をびっしり書き込んだ三ページ分のメモを手にアーサーが行ったり来たりしています。ハンナとテッサは淹れたてのコーヒーを注ぎながら、水曜日までの予定を落ち着いて整理し始めました。まずは場面を英語で聴いてみましょう。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
In your left hand, Arthur.
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
残り三日間の段取りを整理する日曜朝のやり取りを、一文ずつ表現のポイントとあわせて見ていきます。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
'日曜日、月曜日、火曜日 — そして水曜日の三時には市の検査官が歩いて入ってくるんだぞ！'
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
'アーサー、コーヒーをこぼす前に座って熱いまま飲みなさい。'
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
'私たちのホワイトボードを見て：三日間で、やることはシンプルな三つの仕事だけよ。'
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
'たった三つの作業だって?! 昨日までは九号室はほこりと音の鳴らないピアノの鍵盤だらけだったのに！'
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
'日曜日：すべての窓を洗って、あなたの叔母様の古い緑色の芳名録を読むこと。'
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
'月曜日：外のよろい戸を温かみのある緑に塗って、椅子十二脚を並べること。'
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
'火曜日：音の鳴らない鍵盤を修理して、水曜日用のレモンタルトを焼くこと！'
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
'山を三つの小さな丘に分けてくれると、また息ができる気がするよ！'
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
'アーサー、屋根裏にあったあの古い緑色の芳名録はどこに置いたの？'
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
'ちょうどここ、私の脇の下だよ！待てよ、コーヒーカップはどこに置いたんだっけ？'
In your left hand, Arthur.
'社長の左手に持っていますよ。'
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
'社長、十分ほど休んでいて。ハンナとエヴリンさんがその本を読みますから！'
それでは、今の表現を意識しながら、もう一度最初から会話を通して聴いてみましょう。
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday at three o'clock the city clerk walks in!
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Arthur.
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple jobs.
Only three jobs?! Yesterday Room Nine was full of dust and silent piano keys!
Sunday: wash every window and read your aunt's old green guest book.
Monday: paint the outside shutters warm green and arrange twelve chairs.
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!
Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Arthur?
Right here under my arm! Wait, where did I put my coffee cup?
In your left hand, Arthur.
Go rest for ten minutes, boss. Hannah and Evelyn will read the book!
三日間、やることははっきりとした三つの作業 — そしてアーサーの叔母が残した緑色の芳名録がついにテーブルの上に置かれました。またすぐ次の場面でお会いしましょう！
See you soon!
